pgf.mod.name: Prismatic Gem Filter
pgf.page.title: Prismatic Gem Filter
pgf.page.desc: While you hold Prismatic Gem, card rewards stop offering other classes' exclusive cards that your character cannot use.
pgf.master.name: Enable filtering
pgf.master.desc: Off leaves every card reward exactly as the game generates it.
pgf.mode.name: When it applies
pgf.mode.desc: The default value matches the range the relic itself affects.
pgf.mode.gem: Only when Prismatic Gem widens this reward
pgf.mode.any: Whenever another class's card would appear
